idea-plugin.name: Redisson Client Reuse Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Gutter warning icon on a Redisson.create(...) call built inside a regular method body -- Redisson's own Getting Started guide states: "RedissonClient is thread-safe, so create a single instance and reuse it as a shared singleton across your application." A client built inside a method means a brand new connection pool to the Redis/Valkey server gets created on every call.

100% static text/PSI analysis -- matches the class/ method name by simple text, so it works whether the real Redisson jar is on the classpath or not. Java and Kotlin. Confirmed gap: every Redis-related plugin found on Marketplace is a data browser/client tool (Redis Helper, Redis Manager, Redis Client, Redis-Cli), none check RedissonClient reuse in application code.

Stated honestly: v0.1 only flags the direct Redisson.create(...) call. Never flags a call inside a constructor (a legitimate "create once" location).

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.
